page: Microsoft Azure E16-8s_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Esv6 family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, configured with 4 physical cores and 2 threads per core, yielding 8 virtual CPUs. The processor features a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and int8 operations.

This instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, but it is Premium Storage capable, allowing high-performance remote storage attachments. There are no onboard GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1975.0 and strong text processing capabilities. In contrast, memory performance shows some limitations, with a Passmark memory score categorized in the bottom 25%, and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth at 42.29 GB/sec. The system is suited for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, caching layers like Redis, and lightweight language model inference, where its 128 GB memory capacity can be fully leveraged.
